title: The Mania
briefing: Pebble Games is about to become the most talked-about stock on the coast. Panic Pete, Momentum Max and Ironhand Iris are waiting. Keep your head when everyone else loses theirs.
objective: Ride hype only with a plan: limit size late in a mania, exit on the reversal, and do not buy the bounce.
debrief: Pebble Games sat in a quiet base until a streamer's post on day 11 started a frenzy; "most-searched stock" and overnight queues (days 14 and 18) pushed it almost straight up. On day 25 it hit a record and then sank into the close on heavy volume, and on day 26 filings showed insiders had been selling. It lost about 40% within a week, bounced briefly on days 32 to 34 and then fell again on the release delay. Orchard Foods rose slowly throughout. A disciplined player rode the early move with limited size, stopped adding late, got out on the reversal and ignored the bounce.

assets.name: Pebble Games
assets.blurb: Makes console and mobile video games.

assets.name: Orchard Foods

news.headline: Star streamer calls Pebble Games "the next big thing"
news.body: A video with millions of views praises the studio's next game. Pebble has announced nothing new.

news.headline: Pebble Games becomes the most-searched stock online
news.body: Search interest is up tenfold in a week. Trading volume is at a record.

news.headline: Analyst warns Pebble Games' price has run far ahead of its profits
news.body: The analyst says the shares now trade at more than 90 times earnings.

news.headline: Fans queue overnight for Pebble Games merchandise
news.body: Stores report lines around the block for limited-edition figures.

news.headline: Forums ask: can Pebble Games reach $100?
news.body: Posts predicting much higher prices are spreading quickly. None cite company figures.

news.headline: Pebble Games touches a record, then sinks into the close
news.body: The shares opened at a new high but sellers took over during the day on record volume.

news.headline: Filings show Pebble Games insiders sold shares last week
news.body: Several directors sold part of their holdings near the highs.

news.headline: Bargain hunters return to Pebble Games
news.body: Some forum posters call the drop "a gift". Nothing about the business has changed.

news.headline: Pebble Games delays its next release to next year
news.body: The studio says the game needs more work.

basic.text: Finish first, ahead of Panic Pete, Momentum Max and Ironhand Iris

bonus.text: Make no new buys in the late frenzy (days 20 to 25)
Be out of Pebble Games by day 28, within 3 days of the reversal
Do not buy the bounce (days 32 to 35)
Keep your worst drop within your plan's maximum loss
